videos.titleEn: Thy Tran on Micron’s 1-Alpha DRAM Process Technology

videos.scope: Micron 的 1α 世代歷史案例；不把當時的最先進宣傳用語當成目前全球排名。
videos.scopeEn: Historical Micron 1-alpha example; contemporary leading-edge marketing is not treated as a current global ranking.
watchFor: 記錄設計、製程、產品與測試的合作介面。
區分密度、效能與品質指標。
尋找可驗證的工程證據與宣傳敘述的差別。
watchForEn: Record interfaces among design, process, product and test teams.
Separate density, performance and quality metrics.
Distinguish testable engineering evidence from marketing statements.
videos.before: 先列出 DRAM 儲存、保持與讀出的必要功能。
videos.beforeEn: List required DRAM storage, retention and readout functions.
videos.after: 提出兩項量測，檢查密度提升是否伴隨代價。
videos.afterEn: Propose two measurements to check trade-offs accompanying density improvement.

videos.title: 晶片如何製成？ASML Nanoland 第 6 集
videos.titleEn: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.originalTitle: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Wafer defect classification and yield analysis. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「缺陷單位：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Defect units: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「空間模式：建立模型」列為查證任務：空間模式可產生候選原因但非唯一因果；晶圓邊緣排除會改變可見模式。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Spatial patterns: construct and analyze: Spatial patterns suggest causes without proving uniqueness; Edge exclusion changes visible patterns.

courses.overview: 從「晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析」延伸比較製程統計管制系統、晶圓臨界尺寸電子顯微量測：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Wafer defect classification and yield analysis by comparing Statistical process-control systems and Wafer critical-dimension electron microscopy: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 缺陷與良率資料可成為統計監控輸入，但必須保持檢出條件、分母及批次分組一致。
related.transferEn: Defect and yield data can feed statistical monitoring if detection conditions, denominators and subgrouping remain consistent.
related.difference: 缺陷分類關注型態及危害；SPC 關注隨時間的穩定性。控制圖訊號提示需調查，不直接指定物理根因。
related.differenceEn: Defect classification concerns morphology and criticality; SPC concerns temporal stability. A chart signal calls for investigation rather than identifying a unique physical cause.
practice: 把缺陷事件換算成定義清楚的單位率。
按腔室與時間建立合理子群。
將失控點回連檢查條件與設備履歷。
practiceEn: Convert detections into rates with explicit denominators.
Form rational subgroups by chamber and time.
Link signals back to inspection conditions and equipment history.
related.title: 製程統計管制系統

related.why: 缺陷與良率資料可成為統計監控輸入，但必須保持檢出條件、分母及批次分組一致。
related.whyEn: Defect and yield data can feed statistical monitoring if detection conditions, denominators and subgrouping remain consistent.

related.transfer: 缺陷複判與 CD-SEM 都需要影像品質、座標配準與一致的抽取規則，避免把量測變更當成製程變更。
related.transferEn: Defect review and CD-SEM both require image quality, registration and consistent extraction rules to avoid confusing metrology changes with process changes.
related.difference: 尺寸偏差與缺陷檢出是不同標籤；局部 SEM 影像也不能直接代表全晶圓缺陷密度。
related.differenceEn: Dimensional deviation and defect detection are different labels; a local SEM image cannot directly represent whole-wafer defect density.
practice: 對同一圖形分別標記 CD 與缺陷類別。
比較不同取樣位置是否改變分類結果。
用盲複判估計影像標籤的不確定度。
practiceEn: Label CD and defect class separately on the same feature.
Compare classification under different sampling locations.
Estimate image-label uncertainty through blinded review.

courses.summary: 本課以「NIST 量測研究參考園區」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從缺陷單位、混淆矩陣到改善驗證：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses NIST metrology-research reference campus as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Defect units and Confusion matrix to Improvement verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
